ctaText: You don't need a ready plan or formal wording. Write what worries you as you would explain it to a colleague, and I'll read it myself.
areaOrganizations: Organizations I have worked with here

ctaSteps.write: You write the request from your account, with any file that helps.
ctaSteps.reply: I read it and reply in writing, in the same conversation.
ctaSteps.meet: If we need to, we set a video meeting at a time that suits you.

aboutSentence: I learned to ask before I plan. I still do.
qualificationsIntro: The documents that prove this are on the Documents page, opened on request.

listen.title: I listen before I write
listen.text: No plan before I sit with the people who will live its results.

doable.title: I write what can be done
doable.text: A recommendation the team cannot apply tomorrow is not a recommendation.

leave.title: I leave quietly
leave.text: I measure my work by what stays after I leave, not by the reports I leave behind.

expertiseSentence: Three areas joined by one question: who will live with the results of this decision?
